description: Keyword search over a channel's recent messages using case-insensitive substring matching. Scans only up to the last 100 messages; it does not search full history. Returns { matches: [...] } with id, author, content, timestamp. Use discord_read_messages to fetch recent messages without filtering.

channel_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the channel or thread to search.

keyword.description: Case-insensitive substring to match within message content.

limit.description: Max number of recent messages to scan (1–100). Default 100.

name: discord_search_messages
